info.name: Insights.Api Balancing Mechanism Dynamic Bid-Offer Acceptances API

params.name: from
params.description: The "from" start time or settlement date for the filter.

params.name: to
params.description: The "to" start time or settlement date for the filter.

params.name: settlementPeriodFrom
params.description: The "from" settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: settlementPeriodTo
params.description: The "to" settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides the bid-offer acceptance data (BOALF) for a requested BMU.
            
By default, the from and to parameters filter the data by start time inclusively. If the settlementPeriodFrom or
settlementPeriodTo parameters are provided, the corresponding from or to parameter instead filters on settlement
date, allowing for searching by a combination of start time and/or settlement date & settlement period.
Note: When filtering via settlement date, from/to are treated as Dates only

params.name: settlementDate
params.description: The settlement date for the filter.

params.name: settlementPeriod
params.description: The settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: bmUnit
params.description: The BM Units to query. Elexon or NGC BMU IDs can be used. If omitted, results for all BM units will be returned.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides the bid-offer acceptance data (BOALF) for multiple requested BMUs or all BMUs.
It returns the data valid for a single settlement period.
            
The settlement period must be specified as a date and settlement period. The date parameter must be provided in the exact format yyyy-MM-dd.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs: This endpoint provides the latest market-wide bid-offer acceptance data (BOALF). The latest 100 acceptances will be returned.

params.name: acceptanceNumber
params.description: The acceptance id to filter results by.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs:
This endpoint returns bid-offer acceptances for a given acceptance id.
Acceptance ids must be integers.
